d:
Hey there,

I hope you've enjoyed reading the first part of Asha's story! This series has been originally planned as only a trilogy but right now I'm expanding it into a slightly longer series with a good mix of story and expansion!

Currently I'm holding a vote on Patreon whether to make to give a full origin story for the second protagonist, Vespera from the second chapter onwards!

Here is a synopsis for chapter two:

A month after discovering the capabilities of the magical book, Asha stumbles upon a certain spell. What is it? A demonic summon of course. And upon finding the spell, the best course of action is obviously summon said demon and tie her directly to your soul!

Additionally I'm holding an End of Summer Sale on my Patreon with every tier being 20% off! ^^

And if you like my stuff, please check out my Patreon or my Website!
I've also started some small free SFW growth shorts that I share on my patreon recently like this, so it might just be worth to join as a free member too! ^^
